title: Campus pipe in terminal_types.dem is the sole span-15 draw against standard tier's max_span 14
evidence: spawn_node router_mid 20 15 ... spawn_node campus 30 10 ... at 900ms draw 0 6 standard ... append(&cat.pipe_tiers, Pipe_Tier{id = "standard", display = "Standard Line", capacity_units = 15, cost = 10, clean_span = 10, max_span = 14, cost_per_tile = 12, era_introduced = 1})
detail: Router(20,15)→campus(30,10) is dx10+dy5=15 Manhattan; every other pipe in the demo is ≤13. If draw-span is path-length, this command is rejected silently — campus never connects and the 'campuses flood' premise fails.
recommended_fix: Move campus within span 14 of the router (e.g. x=28 gives 13) or use a wide-tier draw; verify the golden actually shows the campus connected.

title: W9 burst failure message hardcodes ceiling 2 after the check became per-type
detail: The ceiling is now per-type (host 2, campus 3) computed from each source's accrue, but the failure message still asserts '2 = ceil_cap', misdiagnosing any campus violation on investigation.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the message to reference the per-type ceil(cap) ceiling (host 2, campus 3).

title: Era-2 roster loop omits the junction-kind assertion its r1/r3 siblings carry
detail: The new era-2 loop checks only era_introduced ≤ 2; the 'never hold a junction kind' invariant is asserted in the era-1 and era-3 loops but skipped here, relying indirectly on len(r2)==2.
recommended_fix: Add the same kind == .Terminal expectf to the era-2 roster loop.

title: House-path geometry computed before the Small_Biz/Campus early return in draw_building fallback
evidence:
h := s * 0.62
 	left := c.x - w/2
 	top := c.y - h * 0.15
+	if role == .Small_Biz || role == .Campus {
+		// 5.11 fallback: flat-roof blocks ... 
+		...
+		return
+	}
detail: w/h/left/top are computed, then the new role branch returns without using them — wasted work on every small_biz/campus fallback draw; the branch belongs above the house geometry.
recommended_fix: Move the Small_Biz/Campus branch above the house-geometry computation.

title: W9 burst loop silently skips dead/off-slot sources, exempting them from the ceiling check
detail: Any same-tick spawn whose source is dead or off-range 'continue's past the per-tick ceiling comparison — a violation from a dying node escapes the pin with no counter or assertion.
recommended_fix: Count the skips and assert zero, or apply the ceiling check before the liveness guard.
